common_symptoms: fatigue, weight loss, fever, night sweats, enlarged lymph nodes
complications: secondary infections, organ failure, bone marrow suppression
affected_organs: lymph nodes, spleen, liver, bone marrow
drugs: bendamustine hydrochloride, rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisolone
epidemiology: 1 in 20 people will develop non-Hodgkin's lymphoma during their lifetime; more common in adults over 65 years old
risk_factors: family_history, genetic_predisposition, age, gender (more common in men), immunosuppression, exposure to certain chemicals or radiation
diagnosis_challenges: nonspecific symptoms, lack of early biomarkers, disease mimics
treatment_challenges: drug resistance, frequent relapse, side effects, poor adherence
